# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 16 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 16:1 — adat remiyah: "congregation of deceit" vs. "assembly of deceit" vs. "community of liars"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "congregation of deceit" | Literal: edah = congregation |
| LOGOS | "assembly of deceit" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "community of liars" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "congregation of deceit."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 16:9 — "change Your words" vs. "alter Your decrees" vs. "rewrite Your words"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "change Your words" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "alter Your decrees" | Interpretive |
| PNEUMA | "rewrite Your words" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "alter Your words" as compromise.
**Status:** Resolved with composite.

---

## 16:13 — "eternal salvation" vs. "eternal deliverance" vs. "everlasting rescue"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "eternal salvation" | Literal: yeshu'ah = salvation |
| LOGOS | "eternal deliverance" | Avoids Christological overtone |
| PNEUMA | "everlasting rescue" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "eternal salvation" -- yeshu'ah is properly "salvation."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 16:15 — "day of slaughter" vs. "day of carnage" vs. "day of massacre"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "day of slaughter" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "day of carnage" | More intense |
| PNEUMA | "day of massacre" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "day of slaughter" -- echoes Isaiah 30:25.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 16:21 — "sign and a wonder" vs. "sign and a portent" vs. "warning sign"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "sign and a wonder" | Standard pair |
| LOGOS | "sign and a portent" | More precise |
| PNEUMA | "warning sign" | Simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "sign and a portent" -- mofet is more precisely "portent" here.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 16:30 — "dread" vs. "awe" vs. "holy fear"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "dread" | Strong literal |
| LOGOS | "awe" | Positive connotation |
| PNEUMA | "holy fear" | Interpretive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "dread" -- context is trembling and terror.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 16:36 — hesed: "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "lovingkindness" vs. "faithful love"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "covenant-faithfulness" | Project convention |
| LOGOS | "lovingkindness" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "faithful love" | Modern |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "covenant-faithfulness" per project convention.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 16:** 7
